ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Saturn

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on your image and your personal energy. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on rest and your inner life. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on friends and plans for the future. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on your career and your goals. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on relationships and partnerships. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on home and family. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The Sun and Saturn are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, discipline and responsibility, all focused on your money and what you value. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.
